description.en-Latn-US: Whose Phenomenon? (activity bank). The exercises the session screens mount, defined once each: the look-fors matching, the phenomenon-or-topic gut-check, the definition in your own words, the kinds-of-question matching, the sort of Ms. Boyd's eight questions, the written discourse contrast, the transcript-marking, the written equity read, the mirror, the anchor choice with its four branch guides, and the justification. The transcript itself lives here too.

Ambitious Science Teaching, Unit 1: Investigating Matter. Before a placement block, a teacher candidate and four classmates study the transcript of their cooperating teacher launching a fourth-grade unit on matter with a frozen Michigan lake, argue about what it did with what four children offered, replay it making her moves against the clock, and plan a launch of their own for the same room.

title.en-Latn-US: Ambitious Science Teaching · Unit 1: Investigating Matter
